//: Kadi began as a handful of static HTML files, and the Vercel project of
that era kept serving them after the Next.js migration -- it ran the build
and then discarded it in favour of a flat public/ directory, so / returned
404 while /invite.html and /scanner.html still resolved as real files.
Pinning the framework here is the guard against that recurring. Project
settings live in a dashboard nobody reviews; this file travels with the
code, so a re-created project or a preview branch builds as Next.js
whatever the dashboard happens to say.
Nothing else is pinned on purpose. The Next.js builder owns its own build
